The conversation turns to 12,000-year cycles and the Younger Dryas period.

Discussion on nationalizing Google to ensure control of information.
Scott Wolter stresses the importance of truth and open discourse.

youtube_description:
Interview with Scott F. Wolter taken at the Conscious Life Expo. The Creative Society Team had the pleasure of speaking with Scott and asking him a few questions. 

Scott F. Wolter is a forensic geologist, television host, and author. He is known for Secrets of the Viking Stone (2020), America Unearthed (2012) and Pirate Treasure of the Knight's Templar (2015).
